item.title: Rikugien Garden — Guide
item.description: Rikugien, in Tokyo’s Bunkyo ward, is widely regarded as one of the city’s most beautiful traditional Japanese gardens. Completed in 1702, this Edo-period ‘strolling garden’ was designed to recreate in miniature 88 scenes from classical Japanese and Chinese poetry, laid out around a large central pond with small islands, wooded hills, winding paths, stone bridges and elegant teahouses. A leisurely circuit reveals ever-changing views, and you can pause at a teahouse for matcha and a sweet overlooking the water.
